desc: White double French doors opening to a shaded Florida porch, with aligned black hinges and handles, a straight threshold, and a plain level and loose hinge screws set on a folded cloth nearby.
reuse_notes: Use for French-door alignment, hinge and strike checks, threshold context, double-door latch problems, and related repair-scope articles. It depicts a generic door setting, never a JK Prestige project or a guarantee that hinge adjustment resolves opening movement.
